corrections.before:
A fire broke out at Iberis Tower in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, Miyato Prefecture, at around 9 p.m. today. Labors belonging to Platoon 2, within the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Security Bureau, rescued people trapped inside.
Public support for the Labor unit has reportedly grown among those who previously distrusted it. However, footage shows the Labors breaking through the building's outer wall to enter, and opinion is divided over whether this was necessary.
corrections.after:

Public support for the Labor unit has reportedly grown among those who previously distrusted it. However, footage shows the Labors breaking through the building's outer wall to enter, and opinion is divided over whether this was necessary.

corrections.before:
Labors from Platoon 2, Security Bureau, Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, were deployed to help rescue people from the fire at the Iberis Tower Building in Sakura Ward, Miyato City, Miyato Prefecture.
The unit was transported to the roof by helicopter and carried out rescues using cables. However, possibly because of an operating error, a Labor damaged the building, sending debris falling to the ground.
Fortunately, nobody was injured, but nearby residents have voiced concerns about the Labor unit.

corrections.before:
Musician Aya Suzumura was caught in the incident during a public live broadcast of her radio program Midnight Sky Garden. The red Angel cut away the part of the building immediately above the live studio.

Suzumura had planned to perform Sky for Two of Us and See You. that day, but the incident forced the show to stop. Some fans were reportedly more disappointed at not hearing her songs to the end than at being caught in the incident.
She reportedly promised the evacuated fans that she would perform in Miyato City again.

Suzumura said, 'After talking with the staff, we considered canceling today's show. But I wanted to convey my feelings to the fans who came and the people listening, so we decided to perform. As a result, everyone was put in danger, and I am truly sorry. But I think the desire to hold a concert on a day like this matters deeply. We will finish this concert.'

corrections.before:
Do you know the term "fire-scene thief"? It refers to someone who steals amid the chaos of a fire or similar situation, and there was just such an incident in the Iberis Tower Building fire.
S, who works on the 19th floor of the Iberis Tower Building, couldn't possibly finish work that day and, resigned to working late into the night, bought a Cherry Blossoms in Full Bloom bento at the nearby convenience store Clover.
Then the fire broke out, and S left the bento behind and evacuated. When S returned to the office after the fire was out, the bento that had been on the desk was nowhere to be found.
S says, "If they were desperately hungry in the middle of a fire, I can't blame them, but I wish they'd at least left the money."

corrections.before:
Research data has been released showing an increase in recent years in young people who cannot solve problems by thinking for themselves.
According to critic Mr. Sahara, an expert on young people's circumstances, the act of "asking when you don't know something" seems to have turned, before anyone noticed, into "asking even about things you could figure out by thinking."

Mr. Sahara said, "Teaching them everything isn't the answer. Sure, it may be easy for the one asking, but it's pretty hard on the one teaching, too. And there's such a thing as the attitude of the one learning. It might be an old-fashioned way of thinking, but in the old days we were told to 'watch and steal it,' and we desperately watched and tried to learn. I wonder if young people today just don't get that."

Changes in the environment surrounding young people may have created the current situation.

corrections.before:
Many of the people rescued from the Iberis Tower Building fire were visitors. Norio Nakagawa (55) is one of them.
Norio's daughter, Sakurako Nakagawa, and her partner had told him they wanted to formally ask for his blessing to marry, and he was waiting for them at the Iberis Café on the top floor of the Iberis Tower Building.
When the two didn't show up, Norio tried to contact them but couldn't get through, and just then he happened to learn on his smartphone that the Sky Garden Bridge, which Sakurako and her partner were supposed to cross, had collapsed.
"I opposed the marriage once. I lost my wife when Sakurako was still little... I'd actually planned to give them my blessing today... I never imagined this would happen..."
So far, Sakurako's name is not among the survivors of the Sky Garden Bridge collapse.

corrections.before:
Just then, someone shook Naran hard.
Regaining a sliver of consciousness, he heavily opened his eyelids. It was Keen.

"Naran! Are you all right?! I can't believe they got you!"
"You don't need to worry anymore. I'm finished."
"I'll treat you right now!"
"Well, do as you like. More importantly..."

Naran handed the dagger at his waist to Keen.
"I'm sorry, but I leave the rest to you."
With that, Naran looked up at the sky and quietly drew his last breath.

"The Tale of the Last Sword, Vol. 1: The Past Chapter" - The End

corrections.before:
Marlo had dragged up this memory from the depths of the depths of his mind, but he realized it didn't seem to be his own. He came from a peaceful country village, and he had never experienced war in his life. He carried a sword for self-defense, just in case, but he preferred magic.

Yet this memory certainly had a vivid sense of presence. There were many odd things about it. The memory of the girl polishing his body, the sensation of being swung around by the girl in a physical sense, the feel of tearing through human skin, and so on...
"...Ah, I see. These are your memories."
Saying so, Marlo gently touched the old sword at his own waist.
The silver one, who resonated with the will of the girl who had owned him, and who still thinks of her.

And so, the one and his blade continue their journey.
Though they can't remember since when they've been traveling, or why.

"The Tale of the Last Sword, Vol. 8: The Recollections Chapter" - The End
